# Nookast

> Nookast is a native Android podcast player for a self-hosted PinePods server. It keeps playback
> progress, played state, favourites and the Up next queue in sync across devices, keeps every
> change on the phone until the server confirms it, falls back to streaming through the server when
> a podcast host is unreachable, turns description timestamps into chapters, and marks podcasts
> that went quiet. It updates itself from this repository's releases. Android 8.0+, free for
> noncommercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0).

## Docs
